1.title: How President Trump Broke the Kennedy Center
1.summary: Internal emails and documents demonstrate the political capture of the institution, including how officials once pursued a plan to unload much of the art collection.

2.title: Pennsylvania Measles Outbreak Leads to an Increase in Vaccinations
2.summary: As the outbreak grows to more than 700 confirmed cases, the largest in the country, some people remain opposed to vaccines and others are rushing to get the shots.

3.title: Markwayne Mullin Lost His Pick to Lead ICE, as He Struggles to Prove His Toughness on Immigration
3.summary: Markwayne Mullin is working to overcome hard-liners’ doubts about his leadership, his position undermined by missteps with the White House.

4.title: Russia Barred Their Party, but These Antiwar Voices Are Still Standing
4.summary: The liberal party Yabloko is fielding 98 candidates in this weekend’s elections, a small miracle for antiwar Russians who cannot openly express their views.

5.title: 'Massive' drone attack on Moscow region sees Ukraine hit oil refinery
5.summary: Moscow's mayor says 450 drones were downed during the "unprecedented attack", in which two people died.

6.title: Hundreds of Drones Target Moscow on Final Day of Russian Elections
6.summary: Ukraine says it used a newly developed ballistic missile in the attacks, which also targeted other parts of Russia.
